Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-2}^{-1}{x}^{5}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{{x}^{5+1}}{5+1}{|}_{-2}^{-1} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{6}}{6}{|}_{-2}^{-1} \\  & =\frac{(-1)^{6}}{6}-\frac{(-2)^{6}}{6} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}-\frac{64}{6} \\  & =-\frac{21}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
